description.narrative: The “Contributing Towards Sustainable Coalitions at Local Government Level in South Africa project” in South Africa, implemented by ACCORD, aims to continue to contribute towards sustainable coalitions at local government level in South Africa ahead of the 2026 local government elections (LGEs). The objective of the grant is to strengthen capacity through experience-sharing and increased conflict resolution and negotiation skills of public officials and political decisionmakers at local government level to mitigate and prevent disputes for effective co-operative governance. The key activities include, maintaining and enhancing the Coalitions Tracker; thematic seminars and workshops to share-experiences and best practices; and advocacy and stakeholder engagements.
